title: Sunday School Song
transcription:
Sunday School Song

Chorus (to be sung between the verses):
Oh, young folks, old folks,
everybody come.
Come and join the Sunday school
and have a lot of fun.
Please check your chewing gum
and razors at the door,
And you'll hear some Bible stories
that you've never heard before.

Verses (to be sung by individuals at random):

The Lord made Satan, Satan made sin;
The Lord made a covered hole
to put Satan in.
Satan got mad and said he wouldn't stay,
He's been acting like the Devil
ever since that day.

The earth was made in six days,
God rested on the seventh;
According to the contract
it should have been the eleventh.
But the workers got drunk
and said they wouldn't work,
So the cheapest thing to do
was fill it in with dirt.

Adam was the first man, Eve was his spouse;
They settled down in Eden
and started keepin' house.
Everything was calm
and peaceful in the main,
Till Eve had a son
and started raisin' Cain.

Noah was a carpenter the finest in the land;
He built an ark and the Lord lent a hand.
Well he marched in the animals
in pairs and pairs,
Except for the worms;
they came in the apples.

Lot lived in Sodom
where the people weren't so great;
So Lot took his family
and he left right through the gate.
Their plan was fine,
but it had one fatal fault:
His wife looked back
and she turned into salt.

Joseph was a shepherd boy,
he kept his fathers goats;
His father used to dress him up
in multi colored coats.
His brothers they got jealous
and threw him in a well;
Joseph went heaven
and his brothers went to--

Shadrach, Meshac, and Abed-nego
Rebelled against the King,
so he said they had to go.
He threw them in the furnace
to burn them all to chaff,
But they wore asbestos BVD's
and gave the king a laugh.

David was a shepherd boy,
a scrappy little cuss;
He met Goliath a-lookin' for a fuss.
Well he picked up a rock
and he beaned him on the dome,
And Goliath saw the birdy singin'
'Home, Sweet, Home.'

David was a-walkin' on the roof
one summer night;
Saw Bathsheba in her birthday suit
and said 'oh what a sight!'
Well, he should have shove for cover,
Yes, he should have turned and ran,
'Cause that's when
all his troubles began.

Sampson was a strongman,
of the Jeffrey Johnson School;
He had the strength of ten men
and the jawbone of a mule.
Along came Delilah
and cut off his curly locks,
And the only strength that Sampson
had was in his dirty socks.

Jonah was a sailor,
who never learned to sail;
He booked a passage
on a trans Atlantic whale.
But the inside of the whale
was crowded at the best,
So he pushed the belly button
and the whale did the rest.

The Pharoah had a daughter,
she had a winsome smile;
She found the infant Moses
a floatin' in the Nile.
She went to her father
with that old familiar tale,
Which is just about as probable as
Jonah and the whale.

Salome was a dancer
she danced before the king;
She wiggled and she woggled
and she shook most everything.
The king said 'Salome,
we'll have no scandal here,'
But Salome said, 'To heck with it,'
and kicked the chandelier.

Paul was from Tarsus
he used to be named Saul;
He persecuted Christians
and thought it was a ball.
Until one day his eyes went dim
and the angel said to stop,
And from that time until his death
he preached until he dropped.
